name: wallstreet-tieling
description: Executable MCP server for Wallstreet Tieling enterprise intelligence and risk discovery.

tools.name: investigate_company
tools.description: Run one-click enterprise investigation and return an investigation_packet with one_click_readiness, report_exports including packet-level agent_decision_digest, directory_bundle verification_recipe, verifier_output_fields, manifest_fields with file_manifest, delivery_checklist, and agent_summary plus directory_bundle.agent_handoff with delivery_files, bundle_integrity, bundle_verification, delivery_checklist, report_visibility, capital_risk_panel, source_strengthening, trust_boundaries, decision_digest, next_actions, relationship graph audit summary, qyyjt_public_origin_handoff report_section_batches and section_work_orders, source-health snapshot, source-resilience recovery step, capital verification queue, relationship graph audit queue, risk brief, profile brief, quality gate, evidence ledger, monitoring seed, report markdown, and evidence graph.

company_name.description: Company name or unified social credit identifier.

company.description: Alias of company_name for API-style callers.

message.description: Natural one-line request; used when company_name/company is omitted.

config.description: Optional datasource YAML path for live retrieval routing.

export_dir.description: Optional directory for DOCX, portable HTML, Markdown, JSON packet, agent-handoff, and manifest outputs.

query_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum seconds per retrieval task before returning a timeout diagnostic, clamped to 0.1..120.

retrieval_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent retrieval tasks, clamped to 1..20.

fanout_rounds.description: Bounded associative expansion rounds, clamped to 0..3.

max_fanout_tasks.description: Maximum generated fan-out tasks, clamped to 0..80.

tools.name: due_diligence
tools.description: Compatibility alias for investigate_company with the same one_click_readiness, report_exports packet-level agent_decision_digest, directory_bundle verification_recipe, verifier_output_fields, manifest_fields file_manifest, delivery_checklist, and agent_summary plus directory_bundle.agent_handoff delivery_files, bundle_integrity, bundle_verification, delivery_checklist, report_visibility, capital_risk_panel, source_strengthening, trust_boundaries, decision_digest, next_actions, relationship graph audit summary, qyyjt_public_origin_handoff report_section_batches and section_work_orders, source repair, capital verification, and relationship audit fields.

tools.name: people_investigation
tools.description: Prepare a public or user-authorized key-person investigation brief.

tools.name: financial_analysis
tools.description: Return the Financial Intelligence Engine checklist for profitability, cash-flow quality, receivables, inventory, capex, related-party transactions, and fraud-signal analysis.

tools.name: anti_nominee_detection
tools.description: Return an evidence-first anti-nominee / beneficial-owner penetration checklist.

tools.name: connector_catalog
tools.description: Return datasource catalog, default-enabled connectors, production/admission decisions, routing blockers, and source policy.

tools.name: retrieval_plan
tools.description: Build an evidence-first investigative retrieval plan from a single company subject before a full run. Returns seed company, graph, and bounded source/task plan.

company_name.description: Company name or unified social credit identifier.

company.description: Alias of company_name for API-style callers.

message.description: Natural one-line request; used when company_name/company is omitted.

limit.description: Limit returned retrieval tasks. 0 returns all tasks.

tools.name: release_readiness
tools.description: Return desktop-agent release contract, remaining gates, runtime_delivery surfaces, latest_acceptance_evidence from npm run acceptance, acceptance_status_counts, release_blocking_surface_count, proof tests, and focused_test_command for Universal, Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, Doubao Office Task Mode, OpenClaude/open-source agents, and WorkBuddy.

tools.name: delivery_closure
tools.description: Return the concise desktop-agent alpha delivery closure checklist with baseline sequence, required verification commands, preserved packet fields, not-current-release boundaries, and final submission open items.

tools.name: release_preflight
tools.description: Return the desktop-agent alpha local packaging go/no-go preflight with package_candidate_ready, final_submission_blockers, package privacy review checklist, required verification commands, and safe release claim.

tools.name: delivery_audit
tools.description: Return the single machine-readable desktop-agent alpha delivery audit with checks, coverage, blockers, verification evidence, safe claim, and final-submission boundaries.

tools.name: objective_audit
tools.description: Return the active objective requirement-by-requirement completion audit with evidence, incomplete items, release gate status, and next actions.

tools.name: development_requirements
tools.description: Return P0/P1/P2/Future development requirement levels, current completion, QYYJT current-version scope, and next focus.

tools.name: agent_tool_adapters
tools.description: Return per-host desktop-agent tool adapter manifest with baseline tool sequence, installation_handoff install/start/smoke contract, execution_matrix done conditions, first_run_recipe preservation guards, fallback order, smoke commands, required packet fields, report outputs, and current-release boundaries for Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, Doubao Office Task Mode, OpenClaude/open-source agents, WorkBuddy, and Universal hosts.

tools.name: aggregate_subject
tools.description: Run bounded subject-profile aggregation for a company, controller, or related entity and return relationship graph/profile details.

subject_id.description: Subject entity id to aggregate, such as company:demo_co or a known profile id.

subject_name.description: Optional readable subject name for report labels.
